shortDescription: 20.19.0.v202611241937 (Deluxe) for CyberLink 9 Languages + RUS + PTB (Enu, Cht, Chs, Jpn, Kor, Deu, Esp, Fra, Ita, Rus, Ptb) (R11)

env.testedBy: AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5) driving the phone over Appium; verdicts and evidence reviewed by WILLY_WU
env.install: TR build 20.19.0.v202611241937 (versionCode 90201902), installed by the tester; the installed APK carries v202611241937
env.scope: every eBug on this TR's verify list (PHD-A rule); PHA262026P0029 not verified (hint never shown) and left off

observations: PHA262026P0029 (not on this QR): on four cleared installs, at display sizes 450, 560 and 680 dpi, the Portrait tab never auto-scrolled and the AI Hair Color hint never showed; RD's note says it cannot be verified in this app version.
AI Edit Agent image requests charge with no cost dialog (6 credits read from the balance and credit history).

rows.title: PHD-A 19.8.0 - AISketch-realistic: The selected style in female is not unselected after selecting a style in male
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: In AI Art, which now holds the female and male style lists, selecting a male style clears the female selection.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.9.2 - AI_Background: The [Generate] button is not lighted up after generating an image
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: After a Custom generation in AI Background the button is lit and can be tapped again.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.10.0 - [Samsung S23]Sign in: The page shows nothing after entering User Sign in
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: The User Sign in page now shows its full content (Email, Password, Sign Up, Google and Facebook sign-in).

rows.title: PHD-A 20.13.0 - Image_to_Video: The sample image is not showing right after changing language and selecting style
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: After changing the system language, each Image to Video style shows its own sample image right away.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.13.0 - [ATFound]ID_Photo: The preview is showing all black after tapping the [X] button in Makeup
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: In ID Photo, tapping [X] in Makeup returns to the normal preview every time, with no black preview.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.15.1 - Image_to_video: Generated video from "Feeling Good" template has no sound but sound setting = ON
rows.creator: ALBERT_CHANG
rows.summary: The video generated from the Feeling Good template with sound on now has an audible sound track.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.16.5 - [UX][Light_mode]Image_to_video: Icon of "Happy Horse" model is not obvious
rows.creator: ALBERT_CHANG
rows.summary: In light mode the Happy Horse model icon is now a dark icon that stands out clearly on the light card.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.18.0 - [UX]AI_Background: There is no [Artwork] button in AI Background
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: AI Background now has an Artwork button that opens My AI Artwork on the AI Background tab.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.18.0 - [UX]AI_edit_agent: UI always focus on photo tab of AI edit agent category even the latest generated result is video after tapping [artwork] button of AI edit agent
rows.creator: ALBERT_CHANG
rows.summary: After a video result, the Artwork button now opens the Video tab of the AI Edit Agent category (Photo tab after an image result).

rows.title: PHD-A 20.18.0 - [CS003208922]AI_Edit_Agent: The cost credits are not the same in rules page and the pop-up dialog
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: The rules page and the generation dialog now show the same costs (video 4 credits per second, image 6 credits).

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Image_to_Video: Reuse opens Custom without the Image to Video explanation sheet shown elsewhere
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Reuse now shows the Image to Video explanation sheet first, then opens Custom with the reused settings.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent][UI] Image_to_Video: Reuse: Custom room flashes rotated (landscape) before settling portrait
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Reuse now opens the Custom room in portrait with no rotated frame during the transition.
